scope: Source-only conceptual audit of V73 intake contract and frozen V72 generic-cue pilot. No model change, fit, forward, private-case or current-result read in this review.
conclusion: V72 proves source training fit and failure on three reused VAL cues. It cannot causally separate small-data/appearance overfit from an unavailable target-reference convention. Both remain live explanations; neither is proved to be the sole cause.
what_is_observed: V72 forward has RGB96/valid, frozen P3 ROI and q/box/L geometry; no arbitrary cue ID, native semantic index, reference coordinate or instance identity token.

Source TRAIN knownD/E is perfect; YCB VAL D0/30 and E10/10. D attention peaks land in uncertainty on TRAIN87/87 but VAL0/30; VAL uncertainty attention mass mean.01243. These are source behavior facts, not a parameter-branch causal experiment.

Public real supervision comprises four TRAIN cues and three VAL cues, with repeated query placements/neutral/full-cover variants. They are generic YCB-object cues, not flat-pallet canonical8 gold; appearances/cue types also change between source splits.

The finite corpus has zero conflicting supervised D/E labels for identical full/effective inputs. It also contains299 effective-crop reference-state D/E collisions handled as non-supervised U. These two observations are compatible.
what_zero_strict_conflicts_proves: The stored finite supervised relation is internally consistent under the audited exact input hash definition.

It does not prove that a single input-only physical/native convention selected every reference, that the convention generalizes to unseen objects, or that a deployment initializer identifies the same target.
A memorizing lookup can fit a finite consistent relation. Conversely, failure to generalize does not itself prove intrinsic impossibility.

explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.source: YCB:000004:001206:000003 FULL_COVER gallery and native RGB
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.fact: The fixed scissors-tip teacher is externally covered by a pasted SPAM can while the occluder has its own visible contours/rim. Other V72 galleries likewise retain or introduce physical cues.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.implication: Some rim/corner/target surface being visible does not establish that the intended fixed target cue is visible.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.limit: This is not a claim that the dataset stores two contradictory labels for one FULL model input. Gallery native64 zoom is diagnostic; actual model crops were independently replayed in the source-data audit.

explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.construction: Hold RGB,q,L,box and target instance fixed. Suppose one physical reference r1 is visible and another r2 is externally hidden, with both uncertainty footprints FULL inside this crop. Choosing r1 as the task reference requires D; choosing r2 requires E.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.implication: If the reference selector/native identity is absent and no shared deterministic input-only convention resolves it, the two tasks have identical inputs and different labels. One arbitrary selected reference per image can hide this ambiguity in a finite corpus.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.limit: No assertion is made that V72 contains this exact two-reference FULL duplicate. Its supervised exact-conflict count remains zero.

explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.construction: An annotated bbox may enclose two stacked/overlapping pallets. The same native index such as front-left refers to a different physical point depending on which pallet is the intended instance.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.implication: Native index alone is insufficient if the input instance proposal does not resolve ownership.
explicit_counterexamples_and_limits.limit: This is an intake risk to test in actual V73 photos, not an unverified claim about every LOCO bbox.

causal_findings.overfit_or_distribution_shift: Strongly compatible with tiny repeated TRAIN fit and failed new-cue attention/classification; not isolated experimentally.
causal_findings.under_specification: A real contract risk: arbitrary per-object teacher identity is absent. Not proven to be the cause of the specific three VAL failures.
causal_findings.distinguishability_from_saved_evidence: Insufficient for a unique causal attribution. More epochs, another loss or stronger backbone cannot by themselves establish reference identifiability.
causal_findings.do_not_claim: V72 failure is solely overfit, solely absent index, or proves the complete task unlearnable.

required_future_primary_target_contract.requirement: Define the eight physical/native meanings, ordering, orientation and symmetry rules independently of the visibility classifier. If a cue has no supported mapping, keep native ID UNKNOWN and out of canonical8 primary supervision.
The queried index must come from the unchanged initializer output slot/order, known at deployment. A random grid row, nearest-q lineage or arbitrary AI cue ID is not a canonical index.

Condition on the actual input-only instance proposal: e.g. instance ROI/box and same initializer8-query set, with documented ownership/stack ambiguity. Resolve multi-pallet annotation entities before assigning physical corners; ambiguous instance/reference remains U.

Native slot index plus same initial8-queryset, input-only target context and available predicted class/orientation may be legitimate if deployment supplies them by the same frozen recipe. Their availability and conventions must be demonstrated, not inferred from source GT.

No reference coordinate, uncertainty range, true offset, GT mask/alpha, post-cover teacher view, GT instance/native token invented from annotation, or image/cue ID lookup may enter inference. Source GT may supervise outputs and establish correspondence only.

Before a fit, count actual per-source/per-slot D/E/S/U and correspondence-supported instances. Generic cue localization can remain an auxiliary/pretraining target; relabeling it native8 by nearest initializer query is insufficient.

Group original/covered/neutral variants and donor lineage in source split, audit hashes/near-duplicate capture families, and freeze new source validation before score exposure. More placements of one cue are not more independent reference instances.

Preserve reference state separately from crop FULL/PARTIAL/MISS. Record multiple candidate references and their target states where possible; audit exact and near-equivalent inputs without forcing unseen/ambiguous references to E.

optional_amodal_reference_target.legitimate_source_label: A controlled cover preserves the previously established physical reference position, so the same amodal-reference coordinate/range can supervise both D and E.
optional_amodal_reference_target.different_output_semantics: Name it amodal reference location, separately from visible cue evidence/visibility. E is not a zero visible heatmap target.
conditions: Do not put the original unobscured teacher view or GT coordinate in deployment inputs.
An occluded point may be uncertain or indistinguishable from input; report uncertainty/compatible ranges.
This is a future separate proposal, not a posthoc V72 fix, ablation result or causal explanation.

consistent: bbox entity versus physical pallet instance
V73_contract_assessment.additional_release_check: Proceed with data intake/actual feasibility counting, but do not mark canonical target learnability PASS merely because images, valid crops and conflict-free arbitrary cue labels exist.
